description: MVP feature tracker for the Agent Project Room v0. Status source of truth for one-feature-at-a-time implementation.

features.name: Project Bootstrap
features.description: Initialize the Next.js App Router project with TypeScript, Tailwind, Vitest, Playwright, Prisma, Pi dependencies, exact dependency saving, and base layout.
features.evidence: Created app scaffold and bootstrap metadata test. Verified with npm run test (1 file, 1 test passed), npm run lint (tsc --noEmit passed), npm run build (Next 16.2.7 build passed), npm audit --json (0 vulnerabilities).

features.name: Domain Types And Constants
features.description: Add schemas, task statuses, artifact statuses, agent run statuses, default agents, and agent mention extraction.
features.evidence: Added failing domain tests first, then implemented domain schemas, default agents, and mention extraction. Verified with npm run test -- src/lib/__tests__/domain.test.ts (5 passed), npm run test (6 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Database Schema And Seed Data
features.description: Add Prisma SQLite schema for users, workspaces, memberships, rooms, messages, tasks, documents, agents, and agent runs; add seed data.
features.evidence: Added failing seeded database test first, then Prisma schema, migration, db singleton, .env.example, and seed data. Verified prisma generate/migrate/seed, npm run test -- src/lib/__tests__/db.test.ts (1 passed), npm run test (7 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Project Room Service
features.description: Add room loading, sorted view model, draft counts, task approval, and document approval service functions.
features.evidence: Added failing room-service tests first, then implemented room view model, draft counts, room loading, and approval functions. Verified npm run test -- src/lib/__tests__/room-service.test.ts (4 passed), npm run test (11 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Pi-Backed Agent Runtime
features.description: Add FeiDingWei room artifact tools, Pi runtime adapter, faux provider defaults, and message-to-agent orchestration.
features.evidence: Added failing Pi tool/runtime/orchestration tests first, then implemented room artifact tools, Pi faux runtime adapter, and agent orchestration. Verified targeted agent tests (6 passed), prisma seed, npm run test (17 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Room And Approval API Routes
features.description: Add message creation endpoint, task approval endpoint, and document approval endpoint.
features.evidence: Added failing API route tests first, then message, task approval, and document approval routes. Added Vitest alias config and Next serverExternalPackages for Pi packages. Verified route tests (4 passed), prisma seed, npm run test (21 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Project Room UI Shell
features.description: Add root redirect, app shell, workspace sidebar, project room header, and initial room page.
features.evidence: Added failing AppShell component test first, then root redirect, room page, and workspace shell. Verified component test (1 passed), prisma seed, npm run test (22 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: Room Tabs And Panels
features.description: Add Chat, Tasks, Docs, Agents, and Activity panels with tab navigation and artifact approval controls.
features.evidence: Added failing RoomTabs test first, then Chat, Tasks, Docs, Agents panels and tab composition. Wired room page to panels. Verified room-tabs test (1 passed), prisma seed, npm run test (23 passed), npm run lint, npm run build.

features.name: End-To-End Agent Project Room Workflow
features.description: Add Playwright coverage for project room load, @PMAgent mention, draft task/doc creation, task approval, and agent activity.

features.name: README And Runbook
features.description: Add README with product positioning, MVP scope, Pi runtime explanation, setup steps, and test commands.

features.name: Final MVP Verification
features.description: Run seed, unit tests, build, E2E checks, local dev server smoke test, and update quality evidence.
